topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just found out my flight is delayed by several hours. This can't be happening. I keep checking the board, hoping it's some kind of mistake, but no luck. I've tried calling the airline, but it just goes to an endless loop of automated responses. I've texted a few friends, thinking maybe they can do something I can't, but honestly, what can they do? I can't afford to miss this event. It's taken so much to get here, and now this. I'm staring at my phone, refreshing the flight status, and I can't sit still. I need to think of something, anything, to get there on time.
